messages:
maria (DevEx): heads up — hitting inconsistent abort semantics across SDKs when backend enforces a short server timeout (5s). Observed in hosted + dedicated.
kevin (SDK): can you paste a minimal repro? is this only streaming or also non-streaming requests? :thinking:
maria (DevEx): non-streaming first — client AbortController in node cancels local streaming handlers but the server still finishes generation and charges tokens. in python, client cancel seems to propagate a different signal and server cancels earlier.
kevin (SDK): ugh. that matches a known difference: node sends `Connection: keep-alive` + cancels the body, python may send `RST_STREAM`/close earlier depending on HTTP client. we rely on transport semantics.
sam (Platform): on Dedicated we also have an nginx front that enforces `proxy_read_timeout 60s` and then our runtime uses a per-request deadline. If client tears down TCP vs HTTP/2 stream cancel differs.
oliver (Eng): note for private deployments we run env var `INFER_REQUEST_DEADLINE_MS`. When that hits we call model cancellation hook which is best-effort — may still finish a token batch.
nina (QA): I can reproduce quickly. Martin's test job: start a long generation with temperature=1, then Abort after 2s. Results: node SDK incurrs tokens, python doesn't. I'll attach logs.
maria (DevEx): here's a tiny Node snippet we used locally:
```js
const ac = new AbortController();
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 2000);
await client.responses.create({model: 'r-instruct', input: 'long text', signal: ac.signal});
```
kevin (SDK): thanks. can you also try forcing `fetch` vs `undici`? our node lib uses `undici` by default but some apps polyfill fetch. abort semantics differ.
maria (DevEx): good call — will try both.
sam (Platform): proposal: we should document expected cancellation behavior per SDK and a recommended server-side pattern: treat incoming stream resets as cancellation, but also support a soft deadline that triggers model abort hook after X ms of no client ack.
kevin (SDK): +1. Also PR incoming from me that unifies our Node/Browser abort plumbing (uses `AbortController` -> `undici` abort controller` mapping). That may reduce the gap. pinging @maria for quick review.
maria (DevEx): ack — can you add a small test case in `sdk-integration` that asserts no extra tokens charged when server receives client cancel? Even just an integration skip for Dedicated.
kevin (SDK): will do. also question: should SDKs surface a `gracefulShutdown` flag that waits for server ack before returning canceled promise? We debated that previously.
oliver (Eng): I'd avoid waiting by default; that makes cancellations slow. Maybe `awaitServerCancelAck: boolean` opt-in.
nina (QA): I'll add tests for streaming and non-streaming. Can we standardize a metric we check? e.g., model tokens consumed delta within 500ms after cancel.
sam (Platform): yep, we'll emit `request.cancelled_by_client` metric with transport hint (tcp-reset / http2-cancel / body-close). that'll help debugging.
ci-bot: build #1245 for kevin/sdk-unify-abort succeeded :white_check_mark: (artifact: sdk-node-abort-fix)
kevin (SDK): thanks bot. I pushed a small docs page under `docs/cancellation.md` in the PR explaining known differences and recommended server hooks.
maria (DevEx): awesome. action items: (1) kevin — PR with tests and docs, (2) sam — platform metric + doc on server-side abort hook, (3) nina — QA matrix for node/python/go streaming & non-streaming cancels, (4) maria — draft short note for customers about what to expect.
kevin (SDK): targeting tomorrow for the PR. can someone thumbs-up the idea of `awaitServerCancelAck` opt-in? :thumbsup:
oliver (Eng): +1 from infra side. use opt-in only.
sam (Platform): +1.
maria (DevEx): ok i'll draft the customer note once the PR lands. thanks all!
kevin (SDK): one more gotcha: Go's http2 client currently doesn't expose stream-level cancel in stdlib; we implemented a context cancel that closes the conn — which can cause more destructive behavior. will file an issue for lib approach.
maria (DevEx): thanks — can you add that to the PR checklist so QA knows to expect different behavior on Go?
kevin (SDK): done. added `go-http2-note` to PR description.
nina (QA): scheduling manual runs for Dedicated + Private tomorrow 09:30 PT.
maria (DevEx): perfect. I'll follow up after QA with updated docs and a short changelog line. :rocket:
